method: Continuous source-art deformation about the bell crown, tapered through the spring into a fixed wooden plaque. Original rope and plaque retained. The separate painted shadow has a delayed motion field; no unpainted hidden metal is invented.

actions.idle: Small wire/coil flex and a slower shadow sway.
actions.attack: Coil tensions right, then the bell swings left twice; the shadow rings a third late echo before all recover.
actions.hurt: Brief rightward recoil, small counter-swing and damped return.
actions.defeat: Metal droops on a slack coil while the ghostly shadow fades; fixed plaque and rope remain.

orientation.method: Authentic bell opening points left; main strikes swing left following rightward anticipation. Recovery and drooped endpoint retain leftward mouth. No reflection or text change.

review_limits: All decoded packing/timing checks passed and chronological poses inspected. Full-speed intended-size visual approval and game integration remain unverified.
